sentences.text: The in-force charge clauses shown are for a home loan, not a car loan, and they state a pre-payment charge on pre-payment or foreclosure.
Those in-force home-loan clauses conflict on the amount, with one stating 2% of principal outstanding and the copy stating 3% of principal outstanding.
The rule findings on UCB prepayment charges do not establish a car-loan foreclosure charge here because applicability is unknown without facility, rate type, or sanction date.

missing.searched: Searched the provided loan policy, loan agreements, and UCB prepayment/foreclosure rule findings for a car-loan foreclosure charge; the documents provided only show home-loan clauses and do not show a car-loan charge.
